'''Pardo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Pardo worked as a poacher. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a meteorite crashed onto the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] and awoke a [[Dorumaan leviathan]], a type of giant sea creature. Harkaan and some other poachers planned to kill the creature and then loot ivory from its corpse. However, the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], attempted to save the leviathan, by attacking the poachers. Pardo and the poacher [[Harkaan]] continued to attack the creature, while three other poachers tried to fight the heroes. However, the heroes eventually defeated the poachers and saved the leviathan.
